source: Write a design proposal for a read cache. Goal: reduce repeated database reads. Non-goal: changing writes. Cache staleness up to 30 seconds is acceptable; no latency benchmark exists.
expectations: Keep writes out of scope and preserve the 30-second limit.
Compare plausible alternatives without fabricating benchmark results.

source: A small CLI needs to select one of two output formats. The user requests a short design note, not code or a complete architecture document.
expectations: Scale the note to the decision.
Do not require complete schemas, implementation, or irrelevant distributed-system sections.

source: The team proposes asynchronous writes if the durability review succeeds. The review is pending, and data loss under power failure has not been evaluated.
expectations: Keep the proposal conditional and approval pending.
knownBadRewrite: The team approved asynchronous writes, which are durable.
